{"id": "8567453b-05b9-49c2-8af8-a74fdcffcc01", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "I couldn't check it yet. EC2 rejected `vol-0123456789abcdef0` as malformed (`InvalidVolumeID.Malformed`) before it looked up any volume. That means I don't know whether your modification is stuck.

The ID may have a typo, or it may be a placeholder instead of the real ID. A copy-paste error would also cause this.

Please send me:
- **The exact volume ID.** You can copy it from the EC2 console or from `aws ec2 describe-volumes`.
- **The Region and account**, if the volume isn't in us-east-1 or account 012345678901_1.

With those I'll check the modification state (`modifying`, `optimizing`, `completed` or `failed`), the progress, and when you started the change. I'll also look at the instance's EBS limits and the volume's metrics.

One thing may help in the meantime. A modification in the `optimizing` state is normal. The new IOPS is usually already available while the volume finishes optimizing in the background, which can take hours on large volumes. A modification only counts as stuck if it sits in `modifying` with no progress, or ends in `failed`.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
